title: Tiny, cute watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body of watering can -->
  <rect x='28' y='45' width='44' height='34' rx='8' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='33' y='49' width='34' height='10' rx='5' fill='#8FE3FF'/>
  <!-- top rim -->
  <rect x='26' y='41' width='48' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#29A8D8'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M62 45 C 78 45, 84 62, 76 78' stroke='#29A8D8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handle highlight -->
  <path d='M64 47 C 77 47, 82 62, 75 75' stroke='#8FE3FF' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M28 55 L 10 30 L 16 26 L 33 50 Z' fill='#29A8D8'/>
  <!-- spout highlight -->
  <path d='M28 53 L 13 31 L 15.5 29.5 L 31 49 Z' fill='#8FE3FF'/>
  <!-- rose/sprinkler head -->
  <ellipse cx='11' cy='28' rx='7' ry='5' transform='rotate(-35 11 28)' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <!-- sprinkler holes -->
  <circle cx='9' cy='26' r='1.2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <circle cx='7' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <!-- water drops -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='20' r='2' fill='#BFEFFF'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='16' r='1.6' fill='#BFEFFF'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='14' r='1.6' fill='#BFEFFF'/>
  <!-- face on body -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='60' r='3' fill='#1B3B4A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='60' r='3' fill='#1B3B4A'/>
  <path d='M46 68 Q 50 72 54 68' stroke='#1B3B4A' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='66' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF9EC4'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='66' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF9EC4'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#29A8D8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='82' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#29A8D8'/>
</svg>
